mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in UNRATE above 4.3% signals weakening labor market conditions, reducing economic growth expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive despite UNRATE rising >0.1pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both GDPC1 (total chained consumption) and HOUST (employment) demand indicators predicts robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both rise >5% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative despite GDPC1 and HOUST rising >5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising), an increase in FEDFUNDS rates signals higher interest costs, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the tightening regime, 20-day returns are positive despite FEDFUNDS rising >0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in INDPRO (supply index) reflects stronger production capacity, boosting investor confidence and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative despite INDPRO rising sufficiently.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in PAYEMS (employment) exceeding 100 thousand persons signals labor market expansion, fostering economic optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative despite PAYEMS rising >100k in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDPC1 (consumption) and RSAFS (durable goods orders) demand indicators predicts robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and RSAFS both rise >5% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative despite GDPC1 and RSAFS rising >5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE >5%), a decline in UNRATE below 5% signals improving labor market conditions, fostering positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the high unemployment regime, 20-day returns are negative despite UNRATE falling below 5% in 1 month.
